label: Bible Study
prompt: And Jesus saith unto him, The _____ have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
verse: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
note: Jesus to an eager would-be follower — even foxes had more of a home than he did.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: In the fear of the LORD is strong _____: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
verse: In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
note: Fear of the LORD brings strong confidence — and a place of refuge for your children, too.

label: Sunday School
prompt: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea: and the sea ceased from her _____.
verse: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea: and the sea ceased from her raging.
note: Over went Jonah, and the sea ceased from her raging — instantly.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the _____ grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.
verse: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.
note: From David's last words: a just ruler is like sunrise after rain on new grass.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be _____ with power from on high.
verse: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.
note: 'Tarry ye' and wait to be 'endued with power from on high' — a promise kept at Pentecost in Acts 2.
